node.title: Cap-row quotient floors require about 2^92 multiplicative amplification
node.statement: At the rate-half cap proxy, among every dyadic one-scale quotient floor reaching sigma*=8,592,912,738, the maximum normalized count is C(128,65), attained at c=2^34 and d=1. Any mechanism that only multiplies one such count must use L>=floor(2^216/C(128,65))+1. This does not exclude a joint construction that changes the box exponent or distinct-slope ledger.
